label_policy: Positive passage IDs were selected by reading passage text before retrieval. They are an initial relevance pool, not an exhaustive gold standard or clinical approval. Metrics against these labels describe this pool only. Expand the pool through independent review before final accuracy claims. Split is assigned before retrieval; holdout is not for tuning.
